name: Brunei Fertilizer Industries Sungai Liang Plant

sources.evidence: BFI states that its plant sits on a 55-hectare site in Sungai Liang Industrial Park in the Belait District and is Brunei's premier ammonia and urea plant.

BFI's plant page lists an ammonia plant, urea synthesis and granulation plants, offsite and utilities plant and dedicated export jetty; nameplate capacity is 2,200 metric tonnes/day ammonia and 3,900 metric tonnes/day granular urea. It records first ammonia production in December 2021 and first urea production in 2022.
